```{r include = F, echo=F}
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(patchwork)
```


# Load Data
```{r}
P.rel <- readRDS("../Data/P.rel.RDS")


```

# All

## Run model
```{r warning = F}
d <- data.frame(sample_data(P.rel))

data <- data.frame(t(otu_table(P.rel)))
data <- decostand(data, method='hellinger') 

dist <- vegdist(data, method='bray')


ord <- capscale(dist ~ Species*Density*Condition, data=d)
adonis2(dist ~  Species*Density*Condition, data=d, perm=999)
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Species, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Density, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Condition, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
#pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=interaction(d$Condition,d$Species,d$Density), p.adjust.m = "fdr")

ev <- eigenvals(ord)
Axis1_exp = round(ev[1] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)
Axis2_exp = round(ev[2] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)

axes <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display="sites", choices=c(1:2)))
names(axes) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
axes <- cbind(d, axes)

p<-ggplot(data=axes, aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, fill=interaction(Species,Density), shape=Condition)) +
  geom_point(size=6,color='black') +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = Species,
      color = Species ),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22,23,24)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes=list(shape = rep(21)))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkorchid3", "firebrick4", "firebrick1",  "goldenrod1","deepskyblue"))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c( "firebrick4", "goldenrod1",  "darkorchid3","deepskyblue"))+
  labs(x=paste0('CAP1 (', Axis1_exp, '%)'), 
       y=paste0('CAP2 (', Axis2_exp, '%)'),
       alpha='none') +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
); p

   
```



# Anasazi and control

## Run model
```{r warning = F}
P.sub <- subset_samples(P.rel, Species == "An" | Species == "CK")
d <- data.frame(sample_data(P.sub))

data <- data.frame(t(otu_table(P.sub)))
data <- decostand(data, method='hellinger')

dist <- vegdist(data, method='bray')

ord <- capscale(dist ~ Species*Condition*Density, data=d)
adonis2(dist ~  Species*Condition*Density, data=d, perm=999)
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Species, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Condition, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist,factors=d$Density, p.adjust.m = "fdr")


ev <- eigenvals(ord)
Axis1_exp = round(ev[1] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)
Axis2_exp = round(ev[2] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)

axes <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display="sites", choices=c(1:2)))
names(axes) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
axes <- cbind(d, axes)


## New one with An L-H+C
p <- ggplot(axes, aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2,
                     fill=interaction(Species,Density),
                     shape=Condition)) +
  geom_point(size=6, color="black") +
  stat_ellipse(data=axes,
               aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2,
                   group=interaction(Species,Density),
                   color=interaction(Species,Density)),
               type="t", level=0.95, linewidth=0.8,
               inherit.aes=FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name="Interaction",
    values=c("CK.CK"="darkorchid3",
             "An.H"="firebrick4",
             "An.L"="firebrick1"),
    labels=c("CK.CK"="Control",
             "An.H"="Anasazi-High",
             "An.L"="Anasazi-Low")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values=c("CK.CK"="darkorchid3",
             "An.H"="firebrick4",
             "An.L"="firebrick1"),
    guide="none") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name="Condition",
    values=c("CK"=21, "N"=22, "R"=23, "SR"=24),
    labels=c("CK"="Control",
             "N"="None",
             "R"="Root",
             "SR"="Shoot + Root")) +
  guides(
    fill=guide_legend(
      order=1,
      override.aes=list(shape=21, size=5, color="black")),
    shape=guide_legend(
      order=2,
      override.aes=list(size=5, fill="white"))) +
  labs(x=paste0("CAP1 (",Axis1_exp,"%)"),
       y=paste0("CAP2 (",Axis2_exp,"%)")) +
  theme_classic() +
theme(
  legend.position="right",
  legend.background=element_blank(),
  legend.box.background=element_blank(),
  legend.title=element_text(face="bold", size=14),
  legend.text=element_text(face="bold", size=12),
  legend.box.spacing=unit(0.05,"cm"),
  legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
  axis.title=element_text(face="bold", size=16),
  axis.text=element_text(face="bold", size=13, color="black"),
  axis.line=element_line(linewidth=0.8, color="black"),
  plot.margin=margin(5,0,5,5)
)

p

```

##No reincorportaiton (without An-H)

```{r}

# 1. Subset samples
# Keep Condition N and CK samples, but remove N.An.H


P.sub <- subset_samples(
  P.rel,
  (Condition == "N" | Species == "CK") &
    !(Condition == "N" & Species == "An" & Density == "H")
)

# Remove taxa that have zero abundance after subsetting
P.sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(P.sub) > 0, P.sub)


# 2. Prepare metadata


d <- data.frame(sample_data(P.sub))

# Remove unused factor levels, including the removed N.An.H group
d <- droplevels(d)

# Check the remaining groups
interaction( d$Condition, d$Species, d$Density,
  drop = TRUE)


# 3. Prepare OTU/ASV abundance table
# Make sure samples are rows and taxa are columns
if (taxa_are_rows(P.sub)) {
  
  data <- data.frame(t(as(otu_table(P.sub), "matrix")))
  
} else {
  
  data <- data.frame(as(otu_table(P.sub), "matrix"))
}

# Make sure metadata and abundance data have the same sample order
d <- d[rownames(data), , drop = FALSE]

# Hellinger transformation
data <- decostand(data, method = "hellinger")


# 4. Bray-Curtis distance
dist <- vegdist(
  data,method = "bray")

# 5. CAP ordination
ord <- capscale( dist ~ Density * Species, data = d)

# View ordination results
summary(ord)

# 6. PERMANOVA

adonis_result <- adonis2( dist ~ Density * Species, data = d,
  permutations = 999)

adonis_result

# 7. Pairwise PERMANOVA

pairwise_density <- pairwise.adonis( x = dist, factors = d$Density, p.adjust.m = "fdr")

pairwise_density

pairwise_species <- pairwise.adonis( x = dist, factors = d$Species,
  p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise_species

# 8. Calculate explained variation
ev <- eigenvals(ord)
Axis1_exp <- round(
  ev[1] / sum(ev) * 100,
  1)

Axis2_exp <- round(
  ev[2] / sum(ev) * 100,
  1)

Axis1_exp
Axis2_exp

# 9. Extract CAP coordinates

axes <- as.data.frame(
  vegan::scores( ord,
    display = "sites",
    choices = 1:2))

names(axes) <- c(
  "Axis1",
  "Axis2")

# Match metadata order to ordination coordinates
d_plot <- d[rownames(axes), , drop = FALSE]

# Combine metadata with CAP coordinates
axes <- cbind(d_plot, axes)

# 10. Create plotting group
axes$Group <- interaction( axes$Condition, axes$Species, axes$Density, drop = TRUE)

axes$Group <- droplevels(axes$Group)

# Confirm N.An.H is not included
levels(axes$Group)

# Expected groups:
# CK.CK.CK
# N.An.L
# N.Cal.L
# N.Va.L


# 11. Create CAP plot

axes$Condition <- factor(
  axes$Condition,
  levels = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR")
)

axes$Group <- interaction(
  axes$Condition,
  axes$Species,
  axes$Density,
  drop = TRUE
)

  p_n <- ggplot(
  data = axes,
  aes(
    x = Axis1,
    y = Axis2,
    fill = Group,
    shape = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = Species,
      color = Species
    ),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Interaction",
    values = c(
      "CK.CK.CK" = "darkorchid3",
      "N.An.L"    = "firebrick1",
      "N.Cal.L"   = "goldenrod1",
      "N.Va.L"    = "deepskyblue"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "CK.CK.CK",
      "N.An.L",
      "N.Cal.L",
      "N.Va.L"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Control",
      "Anasazi-Low",
      "California #5-Low",
      "Vail-Low"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "CK"  = "darkorchid3",
      "An"  = "firebrick1",
      "Cal" = "goldenrod1",
      "Va"  = "deepskyblue"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = c(
      "CK" = 21,
      "N"  = 22,
      "R"  = 23,
      "SR" = 24
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "CK",
      "N",
      "R",
      "SR"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Control",
      "None",
      "Root",
      "Shoot + Root"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        color = "black",
        size = 5
      )
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        size = 5
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("CAP1 (", Axis1_exp, "%)"),
    y = paste0("CAP2 (", Axis2_exp, "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
 theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
) 
   

p_n
```

## Root reincorportaiton (without An-H)

```{r}
P.sub <- subset_samples(P.rel, (Condition == "R" | Species == "CK") &
                          !(Condition == "R" & Species == "An" & Density == "H"))

P.sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(P.sub) > 0, P.sub)
d <- droplevels(data.frame(sample_data(P.sub)))

data <- data.frame(t(otu_table(P.sub)))
data <- decostand(data, method = "hellinger")
dist <- vegdist(data, method = "bray")

ord <- capscale(dist ~ Density * Species, data = d)
adonis2(dist ~ Density * Species, data = d, permutations = 999)
pairwise.adonis(dist, factors = d$Density, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist, factors = d$Species, p.adjust.m = "fdr")

ev <- eigenvals(ord)
Axis1_exp <- round(ev[1] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)
Axis2_exp <- round(ev[2] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)

axes <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display = "sites", choices = 1:2))
names(axes) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
axes <- cbind(d, axes)

axes$Condition <- factor(axes$Condition, levels = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"))
axes$Group <- interaction(axes$Condition, axes$Species, axes$Density, drop = TRUE)

p_root <- ggplot(axes,
                 aes(Axis1, Axis2, fill = Group, shape = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, color = "black") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Species, color = Species),
               type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Interaction",
    values = c("CK.CK.CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "R.An.L" = "firebrick1",
               "R.Cal.L" = "goldenrod1",
               "R.Va.L" = "deepskyblue"),
    breaks = c("CK.CK.CK", "R.An.L", "R.Cal.L", "R.Va.L"),
    labels = c("Control", "Anasazi-Low", "California #5-Low", "Vail-Low")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "An" = "firebrick1",
               "Cal" = "goldenrod1",
               "Va" = "deepskyblue"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = c("CK" = 21, "N" = 22, "R" = 23, "SR" = 24),
    limits = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"),
    breaks = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"),
    labels = c("Control", "None", "Root", "Shoot + Root"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1,
                        override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5)),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2,
                         override.aes = list(shape = c(21, 22, 23, 24),
                                             fill = "white",
                                             color = "black",
                                             size = 5,
                                             stroke = 1))
  ) +
  labs(x = paste0("CAP1 (", Axis1_exp, "%)"),
       y = paste0("CAP2 (", Axis2_exp, "%)")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

p_root

```


# S-R (without An-H)

```{r}
P.sub <- subset_samples(P.rel, (Condition == "SR" | Species == "CK") &
    !(Condition == "SR" & Species == "An" & Density == "H"))

P.sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(P.sub) > 0, P.sub)
d <- droplevels(data.frame(sample_data(P.sub)))

data <- data.frame(t(otu_table(P.sub)))
data <- decostand(data, method = "hellinger")
dist <- vegdist(data, method = "bray")

ord <- capscale(dist ~ Density * Species, data = d)
adonis2(dist ~ Density * Species, data = d, permutations = 999)
pairwise.adonis(dist, factors = d$Density, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
pairwise.adonis(dist, factors = d$Species, p.adjust.m = "fdr")

ev <- eigenvals(ord)
Axis1_exp <- round(ev[1] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)
Axis2_exp <- round(ev[2] / sum(ev) * 100, 1)

axes <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display = "sites", choices = 1:2))
names(axes) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
axes <- cbind(d, axes)

axes$Condition <- factor(axes$Condition, levels = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"))
axes$Group <- interaction(axes$Condition, axes$Species, axes$Density, drop = TRUE)

p_SR <- ggplot(axes,
               aes(Axis1, Axis2, fill = Group, shape = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, color = "black") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Species, color = Species),
               type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Interaction",
    values = c("CK.CK.CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "SR.An.L" = "firebrick1",
               "SR.Cal.L" = "goldenrod1",
               "SR.Va.L" = "deepskyblue"),
    breaks = c("CK.CK.CK", "SR.An.L", "SR.Cal.L", "SR.Va.L"),
    labels = c("Control", "Anasazi-Low", "California #5-Low", "Vail-Low")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "An" = "firebrick1",
               "Cal" = "goldenrod1",
               "Va" = "deepskyblue"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = c("CK" = 21, "N" = 22, "R" = 23, "SR" = 24),
    limits = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"),
    breaks = c("CK", "N", "R", "SR"),
    labels = c("Control", "None", "Root", "Shoot + Root"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1,
                        override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5)),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2,
                         override.aes = list(shape = c(21, 22, 23, 24),
                                             fill = "white",
                                             color = "black",
                                             size = 5,
                                             stroke = 1))
  ) +
  labs(x = paste0("CAP1 (", Axis1_exp, "%)"),
       y = paste0("CAP2 (", Axis2_exp, "%)")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

p_SR
```
